+"""One-time migration: retain protected field ABI while checking initialized use.
+
+The original protected names remain fields (nullable during init/disposal).
+Private accessors in the base class check the initialization invariant.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+
+for path in Path('csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets/Memory').glob('*/Generic/*MemoryLinksBase.cs'):
+    source = path.read_text()
+    pattern = r'private (?P<type>[\w<>]+)\? (?P<back>_\w+);\s+protected (?P=type) (?P<name>\w+)\s*\{\s*get => (?P=back) \?\? throw new System.ObjectDisposedException\(GetType\(\).Name, "Store indices are not initialized or have been disposed\."\);\s*set => (?P=back) = value;\s*\}'
+    matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, source))
+    for match in reversed(matches):
+        name, kind, backing = match['name'], match['type'], match['back']
+        replacement = f'protected {kind}? {name};\n        private {kind} Required{name} => {name} ?? throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);'
+        source = source[:match.start()] + replacement + source[match.end():]
+        # Method calls require initialization; assignments preserve old fields.
+        source = re.sub(rf'\b{name}\.', f'Required{name}.', source)
+        source = re.sub(rf'\b{backing}\b', name, source)
+    path.write_text(source)

+for path, entries in warnings.items():
+ s=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'); lines=s.splitlines(True)
+ for row,code,msg in sorted(entries,reverse=True):
+  if code=='CS1574':
+   name=re.search("attribute '([^']+)'",msg)[1]
+   matches=re.findall(r'(?:class|struct|interface) '+re.escape(name)+r'<([^>]+)>',s)
+   if matches: lines[row]=lines[row].replace('cref="'+name+'"','cref="'+name+'{'+matches[0]+'}"')
+  elif code=='CS1572':
+   # XML names never include C#'s @ escape prefix.
+   name=re.search("tag for '([^']+)'",msg)[1]
+   if name.startswith('@'): lines[row]=lines[row].replace('name="'+name+'"','name="'+name[1:]+'"')
+   elif name=='restriction': lines[row]=lines[row].replace('restriction','substitution')
+  elif code=='CS1573':
+   name=re.search("Parameter '([^']+)'",msg)[1]
+   start=row
+   while start>0 and ('///' in lines[start-1] or lines[start-1].lstrip().startswith('[')): start-=1
+   indent=re.match(r'\s*',lines[row])[0]
+   descriptions={'handler':'Optional callback; null continues without invoking a callback.','substitution':'Values to create or substitute.','restriction':'Values used to select matching links.','constants':'Constants defining the link address domain.','indexTreeType':'Tree implementation used to index links.'}
+   lines.insert(start,indent+'/// <param name="'+name+'">'+descriptions.get(name,'The '+re.sub(r'([A-Z])',r' \1',name).lower()+'.')+'</param>\n')
+  elif code=='CS1711':
+   start=row
+   while '</typeparam>' not in lines[row]: row+=1
+   del lines[start:row+1]
+  elif code=='CS1591':
+   indent=re.match(r'\s*',lines[row])[0]
+   text='Logs link mutations and forwards optional callbacks.' if 'class LoggingDecorator' in lines[row] else 'Returns the break constant when an operation throws.' if 'class NoExceptionsDecorator' in lines[row] else 'Initializes the decorator with its underlying links.' if re.search(r'public (LoggingDecorator|NoExceptionsDecorator)\(',lines[row]) else None
+   lines.insert(row,indent+('/// <summary>'+text+'</summary>\n' if text else '/// <inheritdoc/>\n'))

+seed = Path({str(root / 'seed')!r})
+marker = Path({str(root / 'race-injected')!r})
+if 'push' in sys.argv and not marker.exists():
+    marker.touch()

+        subprocess.run([real, '-C', str(seed), *args], check=True)

+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts'))

+
+
+def git(root, *args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(root), *args], text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).strip()
+
+
+class ReleaseRaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_identical_remote_release_is_repaired_without_a_second_bump(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            directory = Path(directory)
+            remote, first, second = [directory / name for name in ('remote.git', 'first', 'second')]
+            subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '--bare', '-q', str(remote)], check=True)
+            subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '-q', str(remote), str(first)], check=True, capture_output=True)
+            git(first, 'checkout', '-b', 'main')
+            git(first, 'config', 'user.name', 'Test')
+            git(first, 'config', 'user.email', 'test@example.invalid')
+            filename = versions.FILES['csharp']
+            path = first / filename
+            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+            path.write_text('<VersionPrefix>1.0.0</VersionPrefix>')
+            git(first, 'add', '.')
+            git(first, 'commit', '-m', 'Source validated by both writers')
+            git(first, 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'main')

+"""Detect relevant changes using the event's actual base, including deleted files."""
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+
+def categories(paths):
+    result = dict(csharp=False, cpp=False, docs=False, pipeline=False)
+    for path in paths:
+        if path.startswith(("dev/log/", "experiments/")) or path.endswith(".gitkeep"):
+            continue
+        result["docs"] |= path.endswith(".md") or path.startswith("docs/")
+        if path.endswith(".md"):
+            continue
+        result["csharp"] |= path.startswith(("csharp/", "examples/ExternalReferences/")) or path in ("global.json", "Directory.Build.props")
+        result["cpp"] |= path.startswith(("cpp/", "c/")) or path in (".clang-format", ".clang-tidy")
+        result["pipeline"] |= path.startswith((".github/", "scripts/", ".config/")) or path in (".gitpod.yml", "publish-bin.sh", "docfx.json", ".editorconfig", ".gitattributes", ".lycheeignore", ".gitleaksignore", ".pre-commit-config.yaml")
+    return result
+
+
+def git(*args):
+    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args])
+
+
+def changed_paths(event, event_name):
+    if event_name == "pull_request":
+        base = event["pull_request"]["base"]["sha"]
+    else:
+        base = event.get("before", "")
+    if not base or set(base) == {"0"}:
+        return git("ls-files", "-z").decode().strip("\0").split("\0")
+    # Checkout fetches full history, and a missing base is an error, never an
+    # empty diff that silently skips checks. --no-renames includes both paths.
+    return git("diff", "--no-renames", "--name-only", "-z", base, "HEAD").decode().strip("\0").split("\0")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    event_file = os.environ.get("GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
+    event = json.loads(Path(event_file).read_text()) if event_file else {}
+    result = categories(changed_paths(event, os.environ.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME", "workflow_dispatch")))
+    output = "".join(f"{key}={str(value).lower()}\n" for key, value in result.items())
+    print(output, end="")
+    if os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"):
+        with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.write(output)

+"""Native checks adapted from the C++ template's scripts/lint_cpp.py."""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+def run(*args):
+    subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
+
+
+def sources():
+    names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z', 'cpp', 'c'], cwd=ROOT).decode().split('\0')
+    return [name for name in names if name and Path(name).suffix in ('.c', '.h', '.cpp', '.hpp') and (ROOT / name).is_file()]
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('--build-dir', type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    run('clang-format-18', '--dry-run', '--Werror', *sources())
+    if args.build_dir:
+        database = args.build_dir.resolve() / 'compile_commands.json'
+        units = sorted({entry['file'] for entry in json.loads(database.read_text())})
+        if not units:
+            raise SystemExit('No native translation units found for static analysis')
+        run('clang-tidy-18', '-p', str(args.build_dir.resolve()), '--quiet', *units)
+        run('cppcheck', '--library=googletest', '--enable=warning,performance,portability', '--error-exitcode=1', '--inline-suppr', '--std=c++20', '--check-level=exhaustive', '--suppress=missingIncludeSystem', '--quiet', '--project=' + str(database))

+"""Keep actionlint's checks while validating its known queue-key false positive.
+
+actionlint 1.7.12 lacks GitHub's concurrency.queue schema (upstream #657).
+Validate that field here and exclude only that exact obsolete-schema diagnostic.
+Every other syntax, expression and embedded-shell diagnostic remains fatal.
+"""
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import yaml
+
+
+def validate_queue(workflow):
+    scopes = [workflow, *workflow.get('jobs', {}).values()]
+    for scope in scopes:
+        concurrency = scope.get('concurrency', {})
+        if not isinstance(concurrency, dict) or 'queue' not in concurrency:
+            continue
+        if concurrency['queue'] not in ('single', 'max'):
+            raise ValueError('concurrency.queue must be single or max')
+        if concurrency['queue'] == 'max' and concurrency.get('cancel-in-progress', False) is not False:
+            raise ValueError('queue: max requires cancel-in-progress: false')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    for path in Path('.github/workflows').glob('*.yml'):
+        validate_queue(yaml.safe_load(path.read_text()))
+    subprocess.run([os.environ.get('ACTIONLINT', 'actionlint'), '-color', '-ignore', '^unexpected key "queue" for "concurrency" section\\.', *map(str, Path('.github/workflows').glob('*.yml'))], check=True)

+"""Check generated documentation, local links, and the source PDF before upload."""
+from html.parser import HTMLParser
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+ROOT = Path('_site')
+
+class Links(HTMLParser):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.links = []
+
+    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
+        self.links.extend(value for key, value in attrs if key in ('href', 'src') and value)
+
+
+def main():
+    pages = list(ROOT.rglob('*.html'))
+    assert pages, 'DocFX did not generate HTML'
+    assert (ROOT / 'csharp/api/Platform.Data.Doublets.html').is_file(), 'API reference is missing'
+    assert (ROOT / 'cpp/index.html').is_file(), 'C++ API reference is missing'
+    pdf = ROOT / 'csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets.pdf'
+    assert pdf.read_bytes().startswith(b'%PDF-'), 'Source PDF is missing or invalid'
+    errors = []
+    for page in pages:
+        parser = Links()
+        parser.feed(page.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+        for link in parser.links:
+            url = urlsplit(link)
+            if url.scheme or url.netloc or not url.path:
+                continue
+            if url.path.startswith('/Data.Doublets/'):
+                target = ROOT / unquote(url.path.removeprefix('/Data.Doublets/'))
+            elif url.path.startswith('/'):
+                errors.append(f'{page}: unsupported root link {link}')
+                continue
+            else:
+                target = page.parent / unquote(url.path)
+            if not target.exists():
+                errors.append(f'{page}: missing {link}')
+    # Validate our deployment URLs against what this PR will actually publish.
+    # Checking the old live deployment would reject newly fixed pages before
+    # they can be deployed, and miss a removed page that still exists online.
+    for markdown in Path('.').glob('*.md'):
+        for link in re.findall(r'https://linksplatform\.github\.io/Data\.Doublets/[^\s)>]+', markdown.read_text()):
+            target = ROOT / unquote(urlsplit(link).path.removeprefix('/Data.Doublets/'))
+            if not target.exists():
+                errors.append(f'{markdown}: generated deployment target missing: {link}')
+    assert not errors, '\n'.join(errors)
+    print(f'Validated {len(pages)} HTML pages, local links and source PDF')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+            ast.parse(source, filename=name)
+        elif path.suffix == '.json':
+            json.loads(source)
+        elif path.suffix in ('.csproj', '.nuspec'):
+            ET.fromstring(source)
+        elif path.suffix == '.sh':
+            subprocess.run(['bash', '-n', str(path)], check=True)
+        if name.startswith('.github/workflows/'):
+            for action in re.findall(r'uses:\s*([^\s#]+)', source):
+                if not action.startswith('./') and not re.fullmatch(r'[^@]+@[0-9a-f]{40}', action):
+                    errors.append(f'{name}: action must be pinned to reviewed commit: {action}')
+    if errors:
+        raise SystemExit('\n'.join(errors))
+    print('Repository configuration, source sizes, scripts and action pins passed')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+"""Prevent skipped jobs from turning missing validation into a green check."""
+import json
+import os
+
+
+def validate(jobs, main=False):
+    failed = [name for name, job in jobs.items() if job['result'] not in ('success', 'skipped')]
+    if failed:
+        raise ValueError('Validation did not pass: ' + ', '.join(failed))
+    expected = {'changes', 'quality', 'security', 'links'}
+    outputs = jobs['changes']['outputs']
+    pipeline = outputs.get('pipeline') == 'true'
+    for language in ('csharp', 'cpp'):
+        if pipeline or outputs.get(language) == 'true':
+            expected.add(language)
+    if pipeline or outputs.get('csharp') == 'true' or outputs.get('cpp') == 'true' or outputs.get('docs') == 'true':
+        expected.add('docs')
+    if main:
+        if pipeline or outputs.get('csharp') == 'true' or outputs.get('cpp') == 'true':
+            expected.add('credentials')
+        if expected.intersection({'csharp', 'cpp', 'docs'}):
+            expected.add('publish')
+    missing = sorted(name for name in expected if jobs[name]['result'] != 'success')
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError('Required validation was skipped: ' + ', '.join(missing))
+    for name, job in jobs.items():
+        if job['result'] == 'skipped':
+            print(f'::notice::{name} skipped: event/change prerequisites did not require this job')
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    validate(json.loads(os.environ['RESULTS']), os.environ.get('GITHUB_REF') == 'refs/heads/main')

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Shared with link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template;
+# "issue #N" references below point to that repository.
+"""Check broken links for snapshots in the Wayback Machine."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+import time
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+WAYBACK_API = "https://archive.org/wayback/available?url="
+DEFAULT_LYCHEE_OUTPUT = Path("lychee/out.md")
+REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
+REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS = 0.5
+USER_AGENT = "broken-link-checker/1.0 (GitHub Actions CI)"
+
+STATUS_URL_PATTERN = re.compile(
+    r"\[(?:4\d\d|5\d\d|ERROR|TIMEOUT|UNKNOWN)\]\s+" r"(https?://[^\s)]+)",
+    re.IGNORECASE,
+)
+BULLET_URL_PATTERN = re.compile(
+    r"^\s*(?:\*|-)\s+.*?(https?://[^\s|)>\]]+)", re.MULTILINE
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ArchiveResult:
+    """Availability details for one Wayback Machine snapshot."""
+
+    available: bool
+    archive_url: str | None = None
+    timestamp: str | None = None
+
+
+def extract_broken_urls(content: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Extract and deduplicate broken HTTP URLs from a lychee Markdown report."""
+    # Newer lychee reports list followed redirects (and suggestions) in their
+    # own "## ... per input" sections; only the errors are broken links.
+    content = re.sub(
+        r"^## (?!Errors per input)[^\n]*\n(?:(?!## )[^\n]*\n?)*",
+        "",
+        content,
+        flags=re.MULTILINE,
+    )
+    urls: list[str] = []
+    for pattern in (STATUS_URL_PATTERN, BULLET_URL_PATTERN):
+        for match in pattern.finditer(content):
+            url = match.group(1).strip().rstrip(".,;!?")
+            if url not in urls:
+                urls.append(url)
+    return urls
+
+
+def split_recovered_urls(
+    urls: list[str], recovered_text: str | None
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Drop URLs the link re-check found healthy from the archive lookup.
+
+    A URL that never answered lychee but answers the re-check is not a broken
+    link; keeping it in this report would send a healthy URL to the Wayback
+    Machine and fail the job on it.
+    """
+    recovered_set = {
+        line.strip() for line in (recovered_text or "").splitlines() if line.strip()
+    }
+    remaining = [url for url in urls if url not in recovered_set]
+    recovered = [url for url in urls if url in recovered_set]
+    return remaining, recovered
+
+
+def fetch_json(url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Fetch a JSON object with a bounded Wayback Machine request."""
+    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT})
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(  # noqa: S310 - URL targets a fixed HTTPS API
+        request, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
+    ) as response:
+        payload = json.load(response)
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        msg = "Wayback Machine returned a non-object JSON response"
+        raise ValueError(msg)
+    return payload
+
+
+def check_wayback_machine(url: str) -> ArchiveResult:
+    """Return the closest available Wayback Machine snapshot for ``url``."""
+    api_url = f"{WAYBACK_API}{urllib.parse.quote(url, safe='')}"
+    try:
+        payload = fetch_json(api_url)
+        snapshots = payload.get("archived_snapshots", {})
+        closest = snapshots.get("closest", {}) if isinstance(snapshots, dict) else {}
+        if not isinstance(closest, dict) or closest.get("available") is not True:
+            return ArchiveResult(available=False)
+
+        archive_url = closest.get("url")
+        timestamp = closest.get("timestamp")
+        if not isinstance(archive_url, str) or not isinstance(timestamp, str):
+            return ArchiveResult(available=False)
+        return ArchiveResult(
+            available=True,
+            archive_url=re.sub(r"^http://", "https://", archive_url),
+            timestamp=timestamp,
+        )
+    except (OSError, TimeoutError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
+        print(f"  Failed to check Wayback Machine for {url}: {error}")
+        return ArchiveResult(available=False)
+
+
+def format_timestamp(timestamp: str | None) -> str:
+    """Format a Wayback timestamp as YYYY-MM-DD when possible."""
+    if timestamp is None or len(timestamp) < 8:
+        return timestamp or "unknown date"
+    return f"{timestamp[:4]}-{timestamp[4:6]}-{timestamp[6:8]}"
+
+
+def set_output(name: str, value: str) -> None:
+    """Publish a GitHub Actions output and echo it for local runs."""
+    output_file = os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT")
+    if output_file:
+        with Path(output_file).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.write(f"{name}={value}\n")
+    print(f"{name}={value}")
+
+
+def report_archived(url: str, result: ArchiveResult) -> None:
+    """Emit an actionable GitHub notice for an archived broken link."""
+    date = format_timestamp(result.timestamp)
+    print(f"  Archived on {date}: {result.archive_url}")
+    print(
+        f"::notice title=Broken link - Web Archive available ({date})::"
+        f"Broken link detected: {url}\n"
+        f"A Web Archive snapshot from {date} is available.\n"
+        "Suggested fix: replace the broken link with the archived version:\n"
+        f"  {result.archive_url}"
+    )
+
+
+def report_unarchived(url: str) -> None:
+    """Emit an actionable GitHub error for an unrecoverable broken link."""
+    print("  Not found in Web Archive")
+    print(
+        "::error title=Broken link - No Web Archive fallback::"
+        f"Broken link detected: {url}\n"
+        "No archived version was found in the Wayback Machine.\n"
+        "Find an updated URL, remove the link, or add it to .lycheeignore "
+        "if it is a known false positive."
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    """Check every URL in the configured lychee report."""
+    output_path = Path(os.environ.get("LYCHEE_OUTPUT", DEFAULT_LYCHEE_OUTPUT))
+    print("=== Web Archive Fallback Check ===")
+    print(f"Reading lychee output from: {output_path}")
+
+    if not output_path.exists():
+        print("::error::Lychee output is missing; cannot verify broken links")
+        set_output("all_archived", "false")
+        return 1
+
+    broken_urls = extract_broken_urls(output_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    recovered_file = Path(os.environ.get("RECOVERED_URLS", "lychee/recovered.txt"))
+    recovered_text = (
+        recovered_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if recovered_file.exists() else ""
+    )
+    broken_urls, rechecked_healthy = split_recovered_urls(broken_urls, recovered_text)
+    for url in rechecked_healthy:
+        print(f"  {url} never answered lychee but answers the re-check -- not broken")
+    if not broken_urls:
+        print("No broken URLs found in lychee output.")
+        set_output("all_archived", "true")
+        return 0
+
+    unarchived: list[str] = []
+    print(f"Found {len(broken_urls)} broken URL(s). Checking Web Archive...")
+    for index, url in enumerate(broken_urls):
+        print(f"Checking: {url}")
+        result = check_wayback_machine(url)
+        if result.available:
+            report_archived(url, result)
+        else:
+            unarchived.append(url)
+            report_unarchived(url)
+        if index < len(broken_urls) - 1:
+            time.sleep(REQUEST_DELAY_SECONDS)
+
+    all_archived = not unarchived
+    set_output("all_archived", "true" if all_archived else "false")
+    if not all_archived:
+        print("Action required: fix or remove the broken links listed above.")
+        return 1
+    print("All broken links have Web Archive versions.")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Apply bounded Conan 2 compatibility fixes to the pinned upstream recipes.
+
+Header-only dependencies must propagate their headers and link requirements.
+This workaround is kept explicit until the upstream recipes fix their metadata.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import sys
+import subprocess
+
+
+def patch(directory):
+    for recipe in sorted(directory.glob('recipes/platform.*/all/conanfile.py')):
+        source = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(directory), 'show', 'HEAD:' + recipe.relative_to(directory).as_posix()]).decode()
+        source, count = re.subn(r'(class \w+\(ConanFile\):\n)', r'\1    package_type = "header-library"\n', source, count=1)
+        if count != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f'Unexpected recipe structure: {recipe}')
+        source = re.sub(r'^\s*self\.cpp_info\.names\[[^\n]+\n', '\n', source, flags=re.MULTILINE)
+        if recipe.parts[-3] == 'platform.data':
+            source = source.replace('import os\n', 'import os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n')
+            marker = '        get(self, **self.conan_data["sources"][self.version]["source"], strip_root=True)'
+            if marker not in source:
+                raise ValueError('Unexpected platform.data source method')
+            source = source.replace(marker, marker + '\n        for header in Path(self.source_folder).rglob("*.h"):\n            text = header.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")\n            header.write_text(text.replace("constexpr auto constants = storage.Constants;", "constexpr auto constants = TStorage::Constants;"))')
+        recipe.write_text(source)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    patch(Path(sys.argv[1]))

+set -euo pipefail
+: "${GH_TOKEN:?Publishing documentation needs contents: write}"

+# Credentials stay in gh's helper, outside URLs and shell tracing.
+gh auth setup-git
+publish_dir=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$publish_dir"' EXIT
+git -C "$publish_dir" init --quiet
+git -C "$publish_dir" remote add origin "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY.git"
+for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+    base=''
+    if git -C "$publish_dir" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin gh-pages > "$publish_dir/remote-ref"; then
+        git -C "$publish_dir" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/gh-pages
+        base=$(git -C "$publish_dir" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
+        git -C "$publish_dir" checkout --force -B gh-pages "$base"
+    else
+        status=$?
+        if [[ $status != 2 || $attempt != 1 ]]; then
+            echo 'Cannot determine the documentation branch state; refusing to publish.' >&2
+            exit 1
+        fi
+        git -C "$publish_dir" checkout --orphan gh-pages
+    fi
+    # Replace only our outputs. Preserve documentation from other languages.
+    rm -rf "$publish_dir/csharp" "$publish_dir/cpp"
+    cp -R _site/csharp "$publish_dir/csharp"
+    cp -R _site/cpp "$publish_dir/cpp"
+    touch "$publish_dir/.nojekyll"
+    git -C "$publish_dir" add csharp cpp .nojekyll
+    if git -C "$publish_dir" diff --cached --quiet; then exit 0; fi
+    git -C "$publish_dir" -c user.name=github-actions[bot] -c user.email=41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com commit -m "Publish C#/C++ APIs and source PDF"
+    if git -C "$publish_dir" push origin HEAD:gh-pages > "$publish_dir/push.log" 2>&1; then
+        cat "$publish_dir/push.log"
+        exit 0
+    fi
+    cat "$publish_dir/push.log" >&2
+    if rg -qi 'GH006|GH013|protected branch|rule violations|permission.*denied|authentication failed' "$publish_dir/push.log"; then
+        echo 'Documentation publication rejected: configure gh-pages write access/rules for the Actions token.' >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    remote=$(git -C "$publish_dir" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin gh-pages)
+    if [[ ${remote%%[[:space:]]*} == "$base" ]]; then
+        echo 'Documentation push failed without a concurrent branch update; refusing to retry.' >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+    echo "Concurrent gh-pages update; reapplying generated pages (attempt $attempt/3)."
+done
+echo 'Documentation publication could not converge after three attempts.' >&2
+exit 1

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Shared with link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template;
+# "issue #N" references below point to that repository.
+"""Re-check the lychee failures where no host ever answered.
+
+lychee's ``--max-retries`` cannot retry a connection reset during connect
+(lycheeverse/lychee#2297: the error is classified by its phase, and the
+connect phase is answered ``false``), so a healthy URL that answers a RST --
+a normal event for a rate-limiting or load-shedding host seen from a CI
+address range -- is reported as broken without a single retry. This script
+asks those URLs again, outside lychee.
+
+The rule that keeps this from hiding real breakage: a failure carrying a
+status code means a host answered, and that answer is final -- a 404 is
+never re-checked.
+
+Environment variables:
+    LYCHEE_OUTPUT: path to the lychee markdown report (default lychee/out.md)
+    RECOVERED_OUTPUT: where to write the URLs the re-check found healthy
+        (default lychee/recovered.txt)
+    RECHECK_BUDGET_SECONDS: total wall-clock budget for the re-check
+        (default 240; must expire before the job's 10-minute cap)
+    RECHECK_WAIT_MS: initial wait between rounds; doubles every round
+        (default 2000)
+
+GitHub Actions outputs:
+    all_recovered: 'true' when every unanswered link answered healthy on
+        re-check. Consumers must test ``!= 'true'``, never ``== 'false'``:
+        a skipped or crashed step leaves the output empty, and only the
+        ``!=`` form fails safe.
+
+Exit codes: 0 in every case. This script downgrades failures; it never
+raises them, so a bug here cannot turn a green run red.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import re
+import sys
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable
+
+BUDGET_SECONDS_DEFAULT = 240
+INITIAL_WAIT_MS_DEFAULT = 2000
+REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
+# lychee's documented default --accept list and --user-agent; used when the
+# workflow does not set the flags. tests/test_recheck_broken_links.py reads
+# this file and the workflow together, so the two cannot drift apart.
+ACCEPT_DEFAULT = "100..=103,200..=299"
+USER_AGENT_DEFAULT = "lychee"
+WORKFLOW_PATH = Path(".github/workflows/links.yml")
+
+ENTRY_PATTERN = re.compile(
+    r"^\s*(?:\*|-)\s+\[([^\]]+)\]\s+<?([^\s>|)]+)>?"
+    r"(?:\s+\(at [^)]*\))?\s*\|?\s*(.*)$",
+    re.MULTILINE,
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LycheeFailure:
+    """One failure entry from the lychee markdown report."""
+
+    marker: str
+    url: str
+    detail: str
+    answered: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class StillBroken:
+    """A URL the re-check could not recover."""
+
+    url: str
+    status: int | None
+    reason: str
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RecheckResult:
+    """Outcome of re-asking the URLs that never answered lychee."""
+
+    recovered: list[str]
+    still_broken: list[StillBroken]
+
+
+def parse_lychee_failures(content: str) -> list[LycheeFailure]:
+    """Split the report into failures, marking the answered ones final.
+
+    A failure is "answered" when a numeric status marker is present ([404])
+    or the detail says "Rejected status code" -- a host answered, and the
+    answer is final. Everything else ([ERROR], [TIMEOUT], [UNKNOWN]) is a
+    failure where no host ever answered.
+    """
+    failures: list[LycheeFailure] = []
+    for match in ENTRY_PATTERN.finditer(content):
+        marker = match.group(1).strip()
+        url = match.group(2).strip().rstrip(".,;!?")
+        detail = match.group(3).strip()
+        if not url:
+            continue
+        answered = bool(re.fullmatch(r"\d{3}", marker)) or bool(
+            re.search(r"rejected status code", detail, re.IGNORECASE)
+        )
+        failures.append(LycheeFailure(marker, url, detail, answered))
+    return failures
+
+
+def parse_accept_ranges(spec: str) -> Callable[[int], bool]:
+    """Build an "is this status accepted" predicate from a lychee --accept list.
+
+    Accepts the lychee syntax ``100..=103,200..=299,429`` with stray spaces.
+    """
+    accepted: set[int] = set()
+    for part in spec.split(","):
+        trimmed = part.strip()
+        if not trimmed:
+            continue
+        range_match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d+)\.\.=(\d+)", trimmed)
+        if range_match:
+            accepted.update(
+                range(int(range_match.group(1)), int(range_match.group(2)) + 1)
+            )
+        elif re.fullmatch(r"\d{3}", trimmed):
+            accepted.add(int(trimmed))
+    return lambda status: status in accepted
+
+
+def extract_lychee_request_options(workflow_text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Extract the --accept list and --user-agent the lychee step runs with.
+
+    The re-check must judge a URL by the same rules the checker used, so a
+    link lychee would have accepted is accepted here too.
+    """
+    accept = re.search(r"--accept[=\s]+[\"']?([^\s\"']+)[\"']?", workflow_text)
+    user_agent = re.search(r"--user-agent[=\s]+[\"']?([^\s\"']+)[\"']?", workflow_text)
+    return (
+        accept.group(1) if accept else ACCEPT_DEFAULT,
+        user_agent.group(1) if user_agent else USER_AGENT_DEFAULT,
+    )
+
+
+def default_fetch(url: str, user_agent: str) -> int:
+    """HEAD one URL once and return its final status.
+
+    Follows redirects like lychee; a rejected status (4xx/5xx) arrives as an
+    HTTPError carrying the code, which is a host's answer, not a transport
+    failure. Transport failures (reset, timeout, DNS) raise.
+    """
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        url, method="HEAD", headers={"User-Agent": user_agent}
+    )
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(  # noqa: S310 - URL comes from the lychee report
+            request, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
+        ) as response:
+            return response.status
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+        return error.code
+
+
+def recheck_unanswered(
+    urls: list[str],
+    *,
+    accept: str,
+    user_agent: str,
+    budget_seconds: float = BUDGET_SECONDS_DEFAULT,
+    initial_wait_ms: float = INITIAL_WAIT_MS_DEFAULT,
+    fetch: Callable[[str, str], int] | None = None,
+) -> RecheckResult:
+    """Ask every URL once more, round-robin with a doubling wait.
+
+    Runs until everything either answers accepted or the budget runs out.
+    Any answer is final: an accepted status recovers the URL, a rejected
+    status fails it for good, and only a URL that keeps refusing to answer
+    is retried.
+    """
+    is_accepted = parse_accept_ranges(accept)
+    ask = fetch or default_fetch
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + budget_seconds
+    wait_ms = initial_wait_ms
+
+    recovered: list[str] = []
+    rejected: list[StillBroken] = []
+    pending = list(dict.fromkeys(urls))
+
+    first_round = True
+    while pending and time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        if not first_round:
+            if time.monotonic() + wait_ms / 1000 > deadline:
+                break
+            time.sleep(wait_ms / 1000)
+            wait_ms *= 2
+        first_round = False
+
+        still_pending: list[str] = []
+        for url in pending:
+            try:
+                status = ask(url, user_agent)
+            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no answer this round, whatever the cause
+                still_pending.append(url)
+                continue
+            if is_accepted(status):
+                recovered.append(url)
+            else:
+                rejected.append(
+                    StillBroken(
+                        url, status, f"answered {status}, which lychee does not accept"
+                    )
+                )
+        pending = still_pending
+
+    return RecheckResult(
+        recovered=recovered,
+        still_broken=rejected
+        + [
+            StillBroken(url, None, "no answer within the re-check budget")
+            for url in pending
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def set_github_output(name: str, value: str) -> None:
+    """Publish a GitHub Actions step output when a sink is configured."""
+    output_file = os.environ.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT")
+    if output_file:
+        with Path(output_file).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
+            stream.write(f"{name}={value}\n")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    """Re-ask every unanswered URL in the configured lychee report."""
+    lychee_output = Path(os.environ.get("LYCHEE_OUTPUT", "lychee/out.md"))
+    recovered_output = Path(os.environ.get("RECOVERED_OUTPUT", "lychee/recovered.txt"))
+    accept, user_agent = extract_lychee_request_options(
+        WORKFLOW_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    )
+    failures = parse_lychee_failures(lychee_output.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+    final = [
+        failure
+        for failure in failures
+        if failure.answered
+        or not failure.url.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://"))
+    ]
+    unanswered = [
+        failure.url
+        for failure in failures
+        if not failure.answered
+        and failure.url.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://"))
+    ]
+    print(
+        f"Re-check: {len(failures)} lychee failure(s), {len(final)} answered and "
+        f"final, {len(unanswered)} never got an answer"
+    )
+    if not unanswered:
+        print("Re-check: nothing to re-ask.")
+        return 0
+
+    result = recheck_unanswered(
+        unanswered,
+        accept=accept,
+        user_agent=user_agent,
+        budget_seconds=float(
+            os.environ.get("RECHECK_BUDGET_SECONDS", BUDGET_SECONDS_DEFAULT)
+        ),
+        initial_wait_ms=float(
+            os.environ.get("RECHECK_WAIT_MS", INITIAL_WAIT_MS_DEFAULT)
+        ),
+    )
+
+    for url in result.recovered:
+        print(
+            f"::notice::{url} never answered lychee but answers {accept} now "
+            "-- not a broken link"
+        )
+    if result.recovered:
+        recovered_output.write_text(
+            "\n".join(result.recovered) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
+        )
+    print(
+        f"Re-check finished: {len(result.recovered)} recovered, "
+        f"{len(result.still_broken)} still without an answer"
+    )
+
+    if not result.still_broken and len(result.recovered) == len(unanswered):
+        set_github_output("all_recovered", "true")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # The re-check only ever downgrades failures, so any crash here must not
+    # mask itself as a verdict: exit 0 in every case.
+    try:
+        sys.exit(main())
+    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - no crash may raise the gate
+        print(f"Re-check crashed (treating as no recovery): {error}")
+        sys.exit(0)

+"""Validate release credentials, package C++ headers, and publish tested artifacts.
+
+No command prints credential values. CI_VERBOSE adds safe operation summaries.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+import zipfile
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PROJECT = ROOT / "csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets/Platform.Data.Doublets.csproj"
+NUSPEC = ROOT / "cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets/Platform.Data.Doublets.TemplateLibrary.nuspec"
+NAMESPACE = {"n": "http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2011/08/nuspec.xsd"}
+HINT = "Rotate the NUGET_TOKEN repository secret with a valid NuGet push key scoped to both Platform.Data.Doublets packages, or configure NuGet trusted publishing."
+
+
+def info(language):
+    if language == "csharp":
+        tree = ET.parse(PROJECT)
+        return {"id": tree.findtext(".//PackageId"), "version": tree.findtext(".//VersionPrefix"), "notes": tree.findtext(".//PackageReleaseNotes")}
+    tree = ET.parse(NUSPEC)
+    return {key: tree.findtext(f".//n:{tag}", namespaces=NAMESPACE) for key, tag in [("id", "id"), ("version", "version"), ("notes", "releaseNotes")]}
+
+
+def request(url, *, method="GET", headers=None):
+    # Redirects may forward custom NuGet API key headers; never follow them.
+    class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
+        def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, hdrs, newurl):
+            return None
+
+    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers or {}, method=method, data=b"" if method == "POST" else None)
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect).open(req, timeout=30) as response:
+            return response.status, response.read()
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
+        return error.code, b""
+    except (OSError, urllib.error.URLError):
+        return 0, b""
+
+
+def verify_nuget(key, package):
+    package_id = urllib.parse.quote(package["id"], safe="")
+    status, body = request(f"https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/create-verification-key/{package_id}", method="POST", headers={"X-NuGet-ApiKey": key})
+    if status != 200:
+        return f"NuGet API key verification for {package['id']} returned HTTP {status or 'unreachable'}. {HINT}"
+    try:
+        verification_key = json.loads(body)["Key"]
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        return "NuGet did not return a verification key. " + HINT
+    if not isinstance(verification_key, str) or not verification_key:
+        return "NuGet returned an empty verification key. " + HINT
+    # Verify the actual owner/glob against an existing version, not just key validity.
+    status, body = request(f"https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/{package['id'].lower()}/index.json")
+    if status == 404:
+        return None  # First publication; push enforces scope.
+    if status != 200:
+        return f"Cannot verify NuGet package scope: package index returned HTTP {status or 'unreachable'}."
+    try:
+        versions = json.loads(body)["versions"]
+        if not isinstance(versions, list) or not versions:
+            raise ValueError("No versions")
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        return "NuGet package index is malformed; refusing to assume publish permissions."
+    status, _ = request(f"https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/verifykey/{package_id}/{versions[-1]}", headers={"X-NuGet-ApiKey": verification_key})
+    return None if status == 200 else f"NuGet owner/glob verification returned HTTP {status or 'unreachable'}. {HINT}"
+
+
+def preflight(mode, languages, credentials_only=False):
+    errors = []
+    token = os.environ.get("NUGET_TOKEN", "")
+    if not token:
+        errors.append("NUGET_TOKEN is missing. " + HINT)
+    elif mode == "release":
+        for language in languages:
+            error = verify_nuget(token, info(language))
+            if error:
+                errors.append(error)
+    github_token = os.environ.get("GH_TOKEN", "")
+    if credentials_only:
+        github_token = "preflight-read-only"
+    if not github_token:
+        errors.append("GH_TOKEN is missing; release jobs need contents: write and packages: write.")
+    elif mode == "release" and not credentials_only:
+        repository = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "linksplatform/Data.Doublets")
+        status, body = request(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {github_token}", "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
+        try:
+            can_push = status == 200 and json.loads(body).get("permissions", {}).get("push")
+        except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
+            can_push = False
+        if not can_push:
+            errors.append("Workflow token cannot write releases; grant contents: write and packages: write on the release job.")
+    for error in errors:
+        print(f"::{'error' if mode == 'release' else 'notice'}::{error}")
+    if errors and mode == "release":
+        raise RuntimeError("Release preflight failed; no packages or tags were published.")
+    print("Release preflight passed" if not errors else "PR validation continues without publishing credentials")
+
+
+def pack_cpp(output):
+    package = info("cpp")
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    headers = sorted((ROOT / "cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets").rglob("*.h"))
+    if not headers:
+        raise RuntimeError("No C++ headers to package")
+    ET.register_namespace("", NAMESPACE["n"])
+    metadata = ET.tostring(ET.parse(NUSPEC).getroot(), encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
+    target = output / f"{package['id']}.{package['version']}.nupkg"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+        archive.writestr(f"{package['id']}.nuspec", metadata)
+        archive.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", '<?xml version="1.0"?><Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/><Default Extension="nuspec" ContentType="application/octet"/><Default Extension="h" ContentType="text/plain"/><Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/><Default Extension="targets" ContentType="application/xml"/></Types>')
+        archive.writestr("_rels/.rels", f'<?xml version="1.0"?><Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Type="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2010/07/manifest" Target="/{package["id"]}.nuspec" Id="manifest"/></Relationships>')
+        for header in headers:
+            archive.write(header, "lib/native/include/" + header.relative_to(ROOT / "cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets").as_posix())
+        archive.write(ROOT / "assets/icon.png", "images/icon.png")
+        archive.write(ROOT / "LICENSE", "LICENSE")
+        archive.writestr(f"build/native/{package['id']}.targets", '<Project xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/developer/msbuild/2003"><ItemDefinitionGroup><ClCompile><AdditionalIncludeDirectories>$(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)..\\..\\lib\\native\\include;%(AdditionalIncludeDirectories)</AdditionalIncludeDirectories></ClCompile></ItemDefinitionGroup></Project>')
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(output / f"platform.data.doublets_{package['version']}.zip", "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
+        for header in headers:
+            archive.write(header, "Platform.Data.Doublets/" + header.relative_to(ROOT / "cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets").as_posix())
+        archive.write(ROOT / "LICENSE", "Platform.Data.Doublets/LICENSE")
+    print(f"Packed {len(headers)} headers into {target}")
+
+
+def wait_for_package(package, attempts=46, interval=20):
+    """NuGet indexing is asynchronous. Verify anonymously, for at most 15 minutes."""
+    url = f"https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/{package['id'].lower()}/{package['version']}/{package['id'].lower()}.{package['version']}.nupkg"
+    for attempt in range(attempts):
+        status, body = request(url)
+        if status == 200 and body.startswith(b"PK"):
+            print(f"Anonymous NuGet download verified for {package['id']} {package['version']}")
+            return
+        if status not in (0, 404, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Anonymous NuGet download returned HTTP {status}; verification failed")
+        if attempt + 1 < attempts:
+            print(f"Waiting for public NuGet indexing ({attempt + 1}/{attempts}, HTTP {status})", flush=True)
+            time.sleep(interval)
+    raise RuntimeError("NuGet package was not publicly downloadable within 15 minutes; rerun publication to repair without changing the version")
+
+
+def publish(language, output):
+    package = info(language)
+    artifacts = sorted(output.glob(f"{package['id']}.{package['version']}.*nupkg"))
+    if not any(path.suffix == ".nupkg" for path in artifacts):
+        raise RuntimeError("The tested NuGet package is missing")
+    tag = f"{language}_{package['version']}"
+    repository = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY", "linksplatform/Data.Doublets")
+    release_url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repository}/releases/tags/{tag}"
+    status, _ = request(release_url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["GH_TOKEN"]})
+    if status not in (200, 404):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Release lookup returned HTTP {status}; refusing to treat an unknown result as absent")
+    failures = []
+    # Each destination can be repaired independently on a rerun. A failed mirror
+    # must never delete, hide, or prevent repairing a successful public release.
+    for source, token in [("https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json", os.environ["NUGET_TOKEN"]), ("https://nuget.pkg.github.com/linksplatform/index.json", os.environ["GH_TOKEN"])]:
+        command = ["dotnet", "nuget", "push", str(output / f"{package['id']}.{package['version']}.nupkg"), "--source", source, "--api-key", token, "--skip-duplicate"]
+        if source.startswith("https://nuget.pkg.github.com/"):
+            command.append("--no-symbols")  # GitHub Packages has no symbols server.
+        result = subprocess.run(command, check=False)
+        if result.returncode:
+            failures.append(f"Package push to {source} failed (exit {result.returncode})")
+        elif source.startswith("https://api.nuget.org/"):
+            try:
+                wait_for_package(package)
+            except RuntimeError as error:
+                failures.append(str(error))
+    notes = output / "release-notes.md"
+    notes.write_text(f"https://www.nuget.org/packages/{package['id']}/{package['version']}\n\n{package['notes']}\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    if status == 404:
+        target = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
+        subprocess.run(["gh", "release", "create", tag, "--repo", repository, "--target", target, "--title", f"[{'C#' if language == 'csharp' else 'C++'}] {package['version']}", "--notes-file", str(notes), "--draft"], check=True)
+    attachments = artifacts + sorted(output.glob("*.zip"))
+    subprocess.run(["gh", "release", "upload", tag, "--repo", repository, "--clobber", *map(str, attachments)], check=True)
+    subprocess.run(["gh", "release", "edit", tag, "--repo", repository, "--draft=false"], check=True)
+    # Authentication is deliberately omitted to check the reader's actual view.
+    status, body = request(release_url)
+    try:
+        public = json.loads(body)
+        actual = {asset['name']: asset['size'] for asset in public['assets']}
+        verified = status == 200 and not public['draft'] and all(actual.get(path.name) == path.stat().st_size for path in attachments)
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
+        verified = False
+    if not verified:
+        failures.append("Public GitHub release is missing or has incomplete assets; rerun publication to repair it")
+    if failures:
+        raise RuntimeError("; ".join(failures))
+    print(f"Published and verified {tag} and all {len(attachments)} release assets")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["preflight", "pack-cpp", "publish"])
+    parser.add_argument("--credentials-only", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["report", "release"], default="report")
+    parser.add_argument("--language", choices=["csharp", "cpp"], default="csharp")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / "artifacts/packages")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    try:
+        if args.command == "preflight":
+            preflight(args.mode, ["csharp", "cpp"] if args.credentials_only else [args.language], args.credentials_only)
+        elif args.command == "pack-cpp":
+            pack_cpp(args.output)
+        else:
+            publish(args.language, args.output)
+    except (RuntimeError, subprocess.CalledProcessError) as error:
+        # CalledProcessError includes secret argv; only show the exit code.
+        print(f"::error::{error if isinstance(error, RuntimeError) else 'Release command failed (exit ' + str(error.returncode) + ')'}", file=sys.stderr)
+        sys.exit(1)

+"""Restore packaged artifacts in isolated consumers; never test project references."""
+import argparse
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+import zipfile
+from release import ROOT, info
+
+
+def run(*args, cwd):
+    subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, check=True)
+
+
+def smoke(language):
+    package = info(language)
+    feed = ROOT / 'artifacts/packages'
+    archive = feed / f"{package['id']}.{package['version']}.nupkg"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as contents:
+        names = contents.namelist()
+        if language == 'csharp':
+            assert any(n.startswith('lib/net8') and n.endswith('.dll') for n in names)
+            assert any(n.startswith('lib/net8') and n.endswith('.xml') for n in names)
+            assert 'README.md' in names and 'icon.png' in names
+        else:
+            headers = list((ROOT / 'cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets').rglob('*.h'))
+            expected = {'lib/native/include/' + h.relative_to(ROOT / 'cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets').as_posix() for h in headers}
+            assert expected <= set(names), 'Native headers are missing from package'
+            for header in headers:
+                name = 'lib/native/include/' + header.relative_to(ROOT / 'cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets').as_posix()
+                assert contents.read(name) == header.read_bytes(), f'Packaged header differs: {header}'
+            assert 'images/icon.png' in names
+            assert f"build/native/{package['id']}.targets" in names
+            ET.fromstring(contents.read(f"{package['id']}.nuspec"))
+    if language == 'cpp':
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(feed / f"platform.data.doublets_{package['version']}.zip") as contents:
+            for header in headers:
+                name = 'Platform.Data.Doublets/' + header.relative_to(ROOT / 'cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets').as_posix()
+                assert contents.read(name) == header.read_bytes(), f'ZIP header differs: {header}'
+            assert contents.read('Platform.Data.Doublets/LICENSE') == (ROOT / 'LICENSE').read_bytes()
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
+        consumer = Path(temporary)
+        # A separate packages folder prevents a cached published package from
+        # hiding a missing or invalid local artifact with the same version.
+        config = ET.Element('configuration')
+        sources = ET.SubElement(config, 'packageSources')
+        ET.SubElement(sources, 'clear')
+        ET.SubElement(sources, 'add', key='tested-artifacts', value=str(feed))
+        ET.SubElement(sources, 'add', key='nuget.org', value='https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json')
+        ET.ElementTree(config).write(consumer / 'NuGet.Config')
+        properties = '<TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework><OutputType>Exe</OutputType>' if language == 'csharp' else '<TargetFramework>native</TargetFramework><TargetFrameworkIdentifier>native</TargetFrameworkIdentifier><TargetFrameworkVersion>v0.0</TargetFrameworkVersion>'
+        (consumer / 'Consumer.csproj').write_text(f'<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk"><PropertyGroup>{properties}</PropertyGroup><ItemGroup><PackageReference Include="{package["id"]}" Version="{package["version"]}" /></ItemGroup></Project>')
+        if language == 'csharp':
+            (consumer / 'Program.cs').write_text('using Platform.Data.Doublets; using Platform.Data.Doublets.Memory.United.Generic; using Platform.Memory; using var memory = new HeapResizableDirectMemory(); using var links = new UnitedMemoryLinks<ulong>(memory); links.Create(null, null); if (links.Count(null) != 1UL) throw new System.Exception("Package consumer failed");')
+        run('dotnet', 'restore', '--configfile', str(consumer / 'NuGet.Config'), '--packages', str(consumer / 'packages'), cwd=consumer)
+        if language == 'csharp':
+            run('dotnet', 'run', '-c', 'Release', '--no-restore', cwd=consumer)
+        else:
+            installed = consumer / 'packages' / package['id'].lower() / package['version']
+            assert (installed / 'lib/native/include/Platform.Data.Doublets.h').is_file()
+    print(f"Validated packaged consumer of {package['id']} {package['version']}")
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument('language', choices=['csharp', 'cpp'])
+    smoke(parser.parse_args().language)

+"""Produce the existing e-reader source PDF with Python 3 and embedded Unicode."""
+
+import argparse
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def build_pdf(root, destination, font):
+    from fpdf import FPDF
+
+    pdf = FPDF()
+    pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=10)
+    pdf.add_font("DejaVu", fname=str(font))
+    pdf.set_font("DejaVu", size=7)
+    pdf.set_title("Platform.Data.Doublets C# source")
+    for source in sorted((root / "csharp").rglob("*.cs")):
+        if {"bin", "obj"}.intersection(source.parts):
+            continue
+        pdf.add_page()
+        pdf.multi_cell(w=0, h=4, text=source.relative_to(root).as_posix(), new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
+        for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines():
+            pdf.multi_cell(w=0, h=3, text=line.expandtabs(4) or " ", wrapmode="CHAR", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
+    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    pdf.output(str(destination))
+    if destination.stat().st_size < 100:
+        raise RuntimeError("Source PDF is empty")
+    print(f"Wrote {destination} ({len(pdf.pages)} pages)")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=Path("_site/csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets.pdf"))
+    parser.add_argument("--font", type=Path, default=Path("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"))
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    build_pdf(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], args.output, args.font)

+"""Changeset-driven release metadata. PRs test the same versions writers publish.
+
+Inspired by the C#/C++ pipeline templates' changeset and guarded-push scripts.
+Only release metadata may be committed; a changed release base requires new CI.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import subprocess
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+FILES = {
+    'csharp': 'csharp/Platform.Data.Doublets/Platform.Data.Doublets.csproj',
+    'cpp': 'cpp/Platform.Data.Doublets/Platform.Data.Doublets.TemplateLibrary.nuspec',
+}
+PATTERNS = {'csharp': r'(?<=<VersionPrefix>)[^<]+', 'cpp': r'(?<=<version>)[^<]+'}
+RANK = {'patch': 0, 'minor': 1, 'major': 2}
+
+
+def git(*args, **kwargs):
+    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, text=True, **kwargs).strip()
+
+
+def read_version(language, text):
+    match = re.search(PATTERNS[language], text)
+    if not match or not re.fullmatch(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', match[0]):
+        raise ValueError(f'Invalid {language} version')
+    return match[0]
+
+
+def bump(version, kind):
+    numbers = list(map(int, version.split('.')))
+    index = {'major': 0, 'minor': 1, 'patch': 2}[kind]
+    numbers[index] += 1
+    numbers[index + 1:] = [0] * (2 - index)
+    return '.'.join(map(str, numbers))
+
+
+def fragments():
+    entries = []
+    for path in sorted((ROOT / 'changes').glob('*.json')):
+        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+        if not data.get('summary', '').strip() or not data.get('releases'):
+            raise ValueError(f'{path}: summary and releases are required')
+        if any(language not in FILES or kind not in RANK for language, kind in data['releases'].items()):
+            raise ValueError(f'{path}: invalid language or semantic version bump')
+        entries.append((path, data))
+    return entries
+
+
+def validate(base):
+    from changes import categories
+    paths = git('diff', '--no-renames', '--name-only', base, 'HEAD').splitlines()
+    changed = categories(paths)
+    entries = fragments()
+    for language, filename in FILES.items():
+        current = (ROOT / filename).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
+        previous = git('show', f'{base}:{filename}')
+        if read_version(language, current) != read_version(language, previous):
+            raise ValueError(f'{filename}: add a changes/*.json fragment instead of manually changing the version')
+        if changed[language] and not any(language in data['releases'] for _, data in entries):
+            raise ValueError(f'{language} changes require a changes/*.json release fragment')
+    print('Changesets and automatic version policy passed')
+
+
+def prepare():
+    entries = fragments()
+    notes = []
+    for language, filename in FILES.items():
+        applicable = [data for _, data in entries if language in data['releases']]
+        if not applicable:
+            continue
